Date 2023-10-25

Niche

The Digital Content and Technologies(DCT) Bachelor’s Program of National Chengchi University is the nationwide premiere undergraduate program that integrates the College of Communications and College of Informatics (Department of Computer Science) together.

Comparing to the related faculties at home and abroad, DCT offers a unique chance of combining interdiscipline learning.

The Department of Journalism and College of Communications, NCCU, have gone through 70 years of accumulation in its solid research and teaching basis, on the other hand, supported by relevant departments such as art and humanities, sociology, psychology, intellectual property, marketing, innovation and creativity.

Thus, with the combination of communication and information technology, DCT offers a high-quality environment to develop digital storytelling, interaction research, new media art and new media technology innovation.

Positioning

DCT program is offered in the form of double major for students from the entire school, where they learn second skills based on digital content and technology.

The goal of the program is to educate multi-disciplined talents with expertise in humanism, IT design and technical skills.

Evaluating the domestic talent gap of the digital content industry, DCT integrates the teachers’ expertise and research resources from both College of Communications and College of Science, and established its characteristic by planning for future developments based on two cores,  including digital storytelling & entertainment technology and new media & interactive design.

Prospective students

Students from the entire university, who are in their second year of college and upwards.

Students outside the College of Communications and Department of Computer Science take more than two-thirds of enrollment quota.

The actual enrollment quota for each year is based on the double major announcement from the Office of Academic Affairs, NCCU.

Application and Selection

The application schedule is based on the double-major operation procedure of the university.

The application materials include application form, transcript and other beneficial documents for application.

Selection will be made through documentary review by the DCT’s screening committee. An oral examination will be conducted if necessary.

Degree Certificate

The approved DCT students who have completed the required credits to graduate in their original department, as well as completed and pass the required subjects of DCT within the study period, will be awarded with Digital Content and Technology Degree, “Bachelor of Science(BS)” upon their graduation.

本學程學士班學生 —— 王姵淇、鍾函芸，和廣告系同學居佳築組成團隊「水獺搖擺州」，於2023年4月23日至24日參加了首屆「Meta 台灣 AR 黑客松」，獲得第一名的佳績。

團隊以財團法人現代婦女教育基金會為主題製作專屬AR特效，從創傷知情出發，打造出身歷其境的體驗，邀請大家一同了解受害者的心靈。

比賽挑戰在30小時內從無到有完成作品，考驗著團隊合作、’腦力激盪和技術，要如何在時間內梳理邏輯，完成作品的同時還要整理成提案形式上台分享創作，十分具有挑戰性。

最終團隊的作品從創傷知情出發，結合「點亮」、「打開」心房的寓意包裝，以可愛手繪風貫穿的 AR 特效，細膩地描繪生活的小細節，也讓體驗者透過行動，幫助受害者點亮房間，溫暖受害者的心房。三位同學的創作，提供了婦女基金會不同的推廣方式，透過 AR 特效情境式地向大眾推廣 NGO 想傳遞訊息，結合三位成員共同創意、技術，運用科技為議題提出解方，創造社會正面的影響力，表現卓越。

text:

日期：2023-10-16

本學程碩二研究生：李沛宸、鄭伃均、陳佩怡、邱彥閔四位同學，於2023年4月23日至24日參加了Meta台灣擴增實境黑客松比賽，獲得財團法人現代婦女教育基金會的最佳倡議獎。

在這場激烈的比賽中，四位同學充分發揮了自己的專業知識和創意，透過應用擴增實境技術，營造了一個獨特的故事情節，並將合意和不合意的性行為分開，設計出了一個具有不同結局的AR濾鏡。

這個AR濾鏡在評審們的眼中脫穎而出，因為它具有對於現實中日益嚴重的性侵問題提供了一種新的解決方案的潛力。

該濾鏡提供了一個可以幫助人們意識到並警惕不合意的性行為，以及了解尊重和同意對於建立健康的性關係所必須的重要性的方法。

同時，該濾鏡也反映了教育和意識提高，在性侵問題解決方案中的關鍵作用。

該團隊希望透過這個濾鏡，能夠讓更多人了解性行為應當基於同意和尊重，並且鼓勵人們在日常生活中尊重他人的意願。

總的來說，四位同學的創作，對於現代社會中的性侵問題提供了一個具有價值的見解，這項成果的獲獎也反映了他們在技術、創新和社會貢獻方面的卓越表現。

The "114th Gen-Z Innovation & Entrepreneurship Competition," organized by the Taipei City Government's Youth Affairs Commission, encourages young people aged 15–35 to propose innovative startup ideas.

A team from our program—undergraduate students Chen Yu-Sheng and Yu Ming-Jie, and graduate student Chen Wei-Rong—participated under the team name "MUMU 故事玩偶," advised by Prof. Tsung-Yu Hou. The team advanced to the finals and won an entrepreneurship prize of NT$150,000.

Date 2025-08-28

[NSTC 2025 AI Innovation Award](https://dct.nccu.edu.tw/upload/84/doc/41433/AI%E5%89%B5%E6%96%B0%E7%8D%8E.jpg)

The inaugural NSTC AI Innovation Award, co-organized by the National Science and Technology Council and industry partners, seeks cross-disciplinary AI innovations focused on integration, innovation, applicability, and social impact.

A team from our program—comprising undergraduate students Chen Yu-Sheng and Yu Ming-Jie, and graduate student Chen Wei-Rong—competed under the team name "ARC_方舟," advised by Prof. Tsung-Yu Hou and Prof. Yi-Hsiu Chen. Their proposal in the education and entertainment category, "萌芽先聲：灌溉成長的每一句童言，捕捉發展的關鍵一瞬 (Sprouts of Voice: Every Word That Nurtures Growth, Every Milestone That Matters)," won the 2025 AI Innovation Award with a prize of NT$1,000,000.

The team subsequently showcased their work at the Taiwan Innovation Technology Expo – Future Technology Pavilion (Oct 16–18) and received the award at the "AI Future: Innovation Application Technology Forum" on October 18.
